brief: The canvas depicts a vast, dark void where numerous small, luminous particles appear suspended. These particles are locked in celestial orbits, tracing complex, visible paths of light. While the particles maintain a cyclical motion around a central point, their paths are not uniform; they exhibit subtle, periodic perturbations, causing the stable circles to wobble slightly. Following the path of a particle, a glowing trail is left behind, which visibly decays over time, fading gradually into scattered, faint points of light before disappearing completely.

statement: This sketch depicts a cosmic scene of particles suspended in deep space, each tracing an orbital path around a central gravitational point. The orbits exhibit subtle wobbling due to periodic perturbations, creating visually interesting, non-uniform motion patterns. Each particle leaves behind a glowing trail that gradually fades, forming a luminous history of its journey. The visual effect is achieved by rendering all particles and their trails in batches using WebGL's efficient batch drawing capabilities, ensuring smooth performance even with hundreds of animated elements.
